good_thing: (Ithaca, New York): Cornell researchers reported a wireless device, lighter than a U.S. dime, that can record animals’ brain activity as they move through natural settings. In proof-of-concept field tests, groups of mice wore it for more than two weeks, opening a less artificial way to study social behavior beyond the lab.
current_or_history: On September 13, 1609, the Half Moon sailed four miles into the river now called the Hudson. Robert Juet, the ship’s mate, recorded four canoes arriving with a large supply of oysters, traded with the crew for small goods.
tiny_fact: Tardigrades, or water bears, walk with coordinated diagonal pairs of legs, much like insects about 500,000 times their size. Their gait stays broadly consistent even as they speed up.
thought: You do not have to make the whole day useful for it to be enough.
